requirement.text: International Admissions (outside the regular quota): applicant and both parents must be non-Korean citizens, or the applicant must have completed all 12 years of schooling outside Korea; high school graduation from a government-authorised school is required (GED, homeschooling and online credentials not accepted). Selection is by document review (academic records, recommendation letters); no interview for this track. Fall 2027 applications are expected in late March to early April 2027.
